condo: Cheap, Freehold 1br @ Pasir Panjang Rd! High Rental Yield!

history.summary: A 495 sqft freehold 1BR at $828k right at Pasir Panjang MRT (30m), pitched on rental yield. Low quantum and freehold tenure are attractive, but the dossier carries zero URA appreciation/transaction data, so the appreciation case is unverified.
history.rating_rationale: Strong points: freehold, low $828k quantum (broad affordability), and a 30m walk to Pasir Panjang MRT (CCL) with One-North/Mapletree Business City and NUS rental demand nearby supporting yield. But the dossier has no URA appreciation rate, no txn count and no median PSF — the appreciation thesis is entirely unverified, and small shoebox 1BRs face a narrow resale pool and shoebox PSF that lags larger formats. The high score_1000 (731) is yield-driven, not appreciation-proven. The generic clickbait listing title also reduces confidence in the framing.
red_flags: No URA appreciation/transaction data — appreciation unverified
Shoebox 495 sqft 1BR — narrow resale buyer pool, capital growth typically lags
Listing title is generic marketing; project not identifiable from dossier
catalysts: One-North / MBC / NUS tenant catchment supports rental yield

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Genuine rental strength: MRT-at-doorstep plus One-North/NUS catchment gives a deep single-tenant/expat pool; gross yield likely 4%+ at this quantum, the main reason to hold.
